exact.canonical_escape: If a continuous family exits LP+ through an infinite-support boundary, every outside sequence approaching the boundary requires canonical Stieltjes witness order d->infinity in one of the shifts s=0 or s=1
exact.collision_sensor: If beta_1>beta_2>... and r is the first index with m_r>=2, then lim_(s->infinity)(partial_lambda log D_(r,s))^(1/s)=beta_r/beta_(r+1)>1
exact.determinant_flux: For r positive atoms, monic P=product_j(t-beta_j), and D_(r,s)=det(a_(s+i+j))_(i,j=0)^r: D_(r,s)'=tau_(r,s)*Q_s'(P), tau_(r,s)=product_j(rho_j*beta_j^s)*product_(i<j)(beta_i-beta_j)^2
exact.edrei_measure: For F in LP+: dnu=gamma*delta_0+sum_j rho_j*delta_(beta_j), rho_j=m_j*beta_j, m_j positive integers
exact.fractional_guard: For nu=(1/2)delta_1, P(t)=t-1, and s=1, Q_s'(P)=-2: Stieltjes positivity without the integer Edrei residue condition does not orient the wall forward
exact.infinite_support: An LP+ Edrei measure with infinitely many distinct positive atoms makes every finite H_(d,s)=(a_(s+i+j)) positive definite for s=0 and s=1
exact.integer_flux: For Edrei residues rho_j=m_j*beta_j: Q_s'(P)=8 sum_j m_j*(m_j-1)*beta_j^(s+4)*P'(beta_j)^2>=0
exact.newman_consequence: Lambda<=0 iff, for every fixed r and every lambda in (0,1/5] for which H_lambda has only real zeros, limsup_(s->infinity)max(1,partial_lambda log D_(r,s))^(1/s)<=1
exact.null_flux: If s>=1 and P(beta_j)=0 on every positive atom, then Q_s'(P)=8 sum_j rho_j*beta_j^(s+2)*(rho_j-beta_j)*P'(beta_j)^2
exact.open_target: Prove directly from the Phi transform that for every fixed r and every lambda in (0,1/5] for which H_lambda has only real zeros, limsup_(s->infinity)max(1,partial_lambda log D_(r,s))^(1/s)<=1
exact.operator_identity: Q_s'(P)=-2 integral x(E+1)(2E+3)[x^s P^2]dnu+4 double_integral [h_s(x)-h_s(y)]/(x-y)dnu(x)dnu(y), h_s(t)=t*d/dt[t^(s+1)P(t)^2]
exact.orthogonal_convergence: If P_r(t)=product_(j=1)^r(t-beta_j), then pi_(r,s)(beta_i)=O((beta_(r+1)/beta_i)^s) for i<=r and pi_(r,s)=P_r+O((beta_(r+1)/beta_r)^s) coefficientwise
exact.orthogonal_quotient: For the monic x^s*dnu-orthogonal polynomial pi_(r,s): h_(r,s)=Q_s(pi_(r,s))=D_(r,s)/D_(r-1,s) and partial_lambda log D_(r,s)=partial_lambda log D_(r-1,s)+Q_s'(pi_(r,s))/Q_s(pi_(r,s))

proof_boundary: This artifact proves the polynomial Hankel-flux identity, the finite-rank integer-residue orientation and determinant formula, strictness and canonical-order escape at an infinite-support LP+ boundary, and the high-shift determinant signature forced by a repeated atom. It does not prove the required Xi/Phi subexponential determinant-growth estimate, all-order Stieltjes positivity at lambda zero, PF-infinity, Jensen hyperbolicity for zeta, RH, or Lambda<=0.

rows.claim: The Edrei moments obey the radial heat hierarchy.
rows.proof_boundary: Inherited from Lemma 11.22C; no positivity follows yet.

rows.claim: Every shifted Hankel quadratic form is a polynomial square norm when an LP+ representing measure exists.
rows.proof_boundary: The representation is available only on the LP+ side or boundary.

rows.claim: The nonlinear moment hierarchy has an exact polynomial divided-difference flux.
rows.formula: Q_s'(P)=-2 integral x(E+1)(2E+3)[x^s P^2]dnu+4 double_integral [h_s(x)-h_s(y)]/(x-y)dnu(x)dnu(y), h_s(t)=t*d/dt[t^(s+1)P(t)^2]
rows.proof_boundary: The divided difference is interpreted diagonally as h_s'(x).

rows.claim: Entireness quantizes every positive pole residue of the Stieltjes logarithmic derivative.
rows.formula: For F in LP+: dnu=gamma*delta_0+sum_j rho_j*delta_(beta_j), rho_j=m_j*beta_j, m_j positive integers
rows.proof_boundary: This is the Sokal/Edrei LP+ representation, not a property of arbitrary Stieltjes measures.

rows.claim: At finite support the null-form flux separates atom by atom.
rows.formula: If s>=1 and P(beta_j)=0 on every positive atom, then Q_s'(P)=8 sum_j rho_j*beta_j^(s+2)*(rho_j-beta_j)*P'(beta_j)^2
rows.proof_boundary: The polynomial must vanish on the complete positive support.

rows.claim: The finite-rank Edrei wall is nonnegative forward and is strict exactly at repeated factors.
rows.formula: For Edrei residues rho_j=m_j*beta_j: Q_s'(P)=8 sum_j m_j*(m_j-1)*beta_j^(s+4)*P'(beta_j)^2>=0
rows.proof_boundary: Simple factors are tangent at first order.

rows.claim: The first vanishing Hankel determinant has the same multiplicity flux times an explicit positive Vandermonde factor.
rows.formula: For r positive atoms, monic P=product_j(t-beta_j), and D_(r,s)=det(a_(s+i+j))_(i,j=0)^r: D_(r,s)'=tau_(r,s)*Q_s'(P), tau_(r,s)=product_j(rho_j*beta_j^s)*product_(i<j)(beta_i-beta_j)^2
rows.proof_boundary: Stated for s>=1 so the optional exponential atom at zero is invisible.

rows.claim: The r=1 specialization recovers the previous repeated-zero 2x2 formula.
rows.proof_boundary: This is a consistency check, not a new closing estimate.

rows.claim: A positive Stieltjes atom with non-Edrei residue can point out of the cone even under forward heat.
rows.formula: For nu=(1/2)delta_1, P(t)=t-1, and s=1, Q_s'(P)=-2: Stieltjes positivity without the integer Edrei residue condition does not orient the wall forward
rows.proof_boundary: Its logarithmic primitive is not entire; the example isolates why residue quantization matters.

rows.claim: Infinite LP+ support makes every fixed finite shifted Hankel block strictly positive.
rows.formula: An LP+ Edrei measure with infinitely many distinct positive atoms makes every finite H_(d,s)=(a_(s+i+j)) positive definite for s=0 and s=1
rows.proof_boundary: Strict finite blocks do not supply a uniform all-order margin.

rows.claim: Approach to an infinite-support Newman boundary cannot be detected at one fixed canonical Hankel order.
rows.formula: If a continuous family exits LP+ through an infinite-support boundary, every outside sequence approaching the boundary requires canonical Stieltjes witness order d->infinity in one of the shifts s=0 or s=1
rows.proof_boundary: Finite order-eleven and finite-shift certificates remain bounded evidence.

rows.claim: For s>=1, Cauchy-Binet expands every shifted determinant as a positive sum of weighted squared Vandermondes.
rows.formula: For s>=1: D_(d,s)=sum_(|J|=d+1) product_(j in J)(rho_j*beta_j^s)*V(beta_J)^2
rows.proof_boundary: At s=0 the optional gamma*delta_0 atom adds nonnegative Cauchy-Binet terms; the displayed positive-atom sum still proves strictness.

rows.claim: The first repeated atom forces exponential growth of one fixed-size shifted determinant logarithmic derivative.
rows.formula: For the monic x^s*dnu-orthogonal polynomial pi_(r,s): h_(r,s)=Q_s(pi_(r,s))=D_(r,s)/D_(r-1,s) and partial_lambda log D_(r,s)=partial_lambda log D_(r-1,s)+Q_s'(pi_(r,s))/Q_s(pi_(r,s)); If beta_1>beta_2>... and r is the first index with m_r>=2, then lim_(s->infinity)(partial_lambda log D_(r,s))^(1/s)=beta_r/beta_(r+1)>1
rows.proof_boundary: The Schur quotient and orthogonality remove the coefficient-derivative term; the ratio beta_r/beta_(r+1) is greater than one because the distinct atoms are strictly ordered.

rows.claim: Two simple atoms have only polynomial shifted determinant logarithmic growth.
rows.proof_boundary: Shows that the exponential signature is multiplicity-sensitive.

rows.claim: A repeated leading atom gives the predicted exponential signature exactly.
rows.proof_boundary: A finite LP+ witness, not the Xi function.

rows.claim: The fixed-size subexponential high-shift determinant-flux criterion is exactly equivalent to Lambda<=0.
rows.formula: Lambda<=0 iff, for every fixed r and every lambda in (0,1/5] for which H_lambda has only real zeros, limsup_(s->infinity)max(1,partial_lambda log D_(r,s))^(1/s)<=1
rows.proof_boundary: The forward direction uses positive-time simplicity; the reverse direction uses positive-boundary attainment and the collision sensor.

rows.claim: A subexponential fixed-size determinant-flux theorem would exclude every positive Newman collision.
rows.formula: Prove directly from the Phi transform that for every fixed r and every lambda in (0,1/5] for which H_lambda has only real zeros, limsup_(s->infinity)max(1,partial_lambda log D_(r,s))^(1/s)<=1
rows.proof_boundary: No such Xi/Phi-specific estimate is proved here.

rows.claim: The gate separates exact flux, exact asymptotics, countermodels, and the missing Phi estimate.
rows.formula: finite-rank flux and collision sensor proved; Xi/Phi subexponential bound open
rows.proof_boundary: Nothing in this artifact proves PF-infinity, RH, or Lambda<=0.

status: exact finite-rank Hankel boundary flux, infinite-support order escape, and high-shift collision sensor with one open Xi/Phi determinant-growth gate
